_comment: THE spot table for the title-screen panoramas (.github/workflows/panoramas.yml, OriginDevPanorama).
One entry = one 6-face panorama, rendered in CI by the 'capture' module with a real shader pack,
then shipped as assets/minecraft/textures/gui/title/background/panorama_0..5.png in every module
capture: the module that renders it. An update's content renders in its own module when that
module can capture; older updates (1.16-1.21) render in 1.21.1, whose worlds still generate
them unchanged and whose Iris/Sodium are the most proven in CI.
locate: the arguments after /locate (biome <id> | structure <id>); offset [dx, dz] from the result.
ground: surface (heightmap, default) or floor (first air over solid scanning down: Nether, caves).
vista: search radius for the highest ground (an overlook). up: camera feet above the ground.
yaw: face 0's direction (0 = south, 90 = west, 180 = north, -90 = east); faces 1-3 turn +90 each.
time: /time set value (daylight cycle frozen). renderDistance: chunks.
mobs: summoned NoAI in view of face 0 at dist blocks, angle degrees off face 0's centre,
up blocks above their ground, turn = extra yaw for a 3/4 view, nbt merged into the summon.
commands: run at the camera's ground point facing face 0 (so ~ and ^ coordinates work).

shaderpack.name: Photon
shaderpack.license: Photon Shaders License Agreement (github.com/sixthsurge/photon/blob/main/LICENSE): 'Use Photon Shaders, including for commercially published screenshots and videos.' Origin never ships or redistributes the pack, only its own renders.
